target.statement: DA-IQA achieves SROCC of 0.977 on the LIVE dataset (cross-validation), outperforming all compared NR-IQA methods.

compute.basis: Requires training a VAE-GAN restoration network on 94,880 Waterloo Exploration images (GTX 1080Ti, batch 32) plus a regression network on LIVE, with no released code; on a CPU-only laptop this is infeasible within hours.

blockers: No code or pretrained models released
Requires GPU training of a GAN/VAE restoration network on ~95k images
Full pipeline (DA-Restore pretraining + quality regression) is complex and not reproducible from paper alone in a few hours
title: Domain Fingerprints for No-reference Image Quality Assessment
